title: Step-Wise Refusal Dynamics in Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.02600v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering parallel decoding, competitive generation quality, and initial evidence of improved jailbreak robustness. Despite this progress, the role of sampling mechanisms in shaping refusal behavior remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive study of step-wise refusal dynamics. We show that diffusion remasking can promote recovery from harmful intermediate generations, provide evidence that this behavior is tied to the sampling mechanism, and demonstrate that switching from AR to diffusion sampling improves jailbreak robustness, including under fixed model weights. To capture generation dynamics not observable at the text level, we propose the Step-Wise Refusal Internal Dynamics (SRI) signal. translated_title: 自回归与扩散语言模型中的逐步拒答动力学
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）近来已成为自回归（AR）模型的有力竞争替代方案，具备并行解码、具有竞争力的生成质量，以及改进越狱鲁棒性的初步证据。尽管取得了这些进展，采样机制在塑造拒答行为中所扮演的角色仍鲜为人知。为填补这一空白，我们对逐步拒答动力学进行了全面研究。我们证明扩散重掩码（remasking）能够促进模型从有害的中间生成内容中恢复，提供证据表明该行为与采样机制紧密相关，并证明从自回归采样切换到扩散采样可以提升越狱鲁棒性，即使在模型权重固定的情况下也是如此。为了捕捉文本层面无法观察到的生成动力学，我们提出了逐步拒答内部动力学（Step-Wise Refusal Internal Dynamics, SRI）信号。与文本层面的发现相一致，SRI表明恢复失败主要发生在自回归采样下。
tldr: 该论文提出逐步拒答内部动力学（SRI）信号，揭示了扩散语言模型的重掩码采样机制能够从有害的中间生成内容中恢复，从而显著提升越狱鲁棒性，且这一优势在固定模型权重、仅切换采样方式时依然成立。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Step-Wise Refusal Internal Dynamics (SRI) signal, showing that diffusion remasking enables recovery from harmful intermediate generations and improves jailbreak robustness, even when switching only the sampling mechanism under fixed model weights.
